### DICK'S Sporting Goods Announces Participation in the Goldman Sachs 33rd Annual Global Consumer and Retail Conference


08/31/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/510074553/files/doc_news/DICKS-Sporting-Goods-Announces-Participation-in-the-Goldman-Sachs-33rd-Annual-Global-Consumer-and-Retail-Conference-2026.pdf)


PITTSBURGH


, Aug. 31, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. (NYSE: DKS) today announced that management will participate in a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs 33rd Annual Global Consumer and Retail Conference


on Monday, September 14th at 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time.


The event will be webcast and can be accessed live or as an archived replay from the link on the DICK'S Sporting Goods' Investor Relations website at[investors.DICKS.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=2905960711&u=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.dicks.com%2F&a=investors.DICKS.com) .


**About DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc.**


DICK'S Sporting Goods creates confidence and excitement by inspiring, supporting and personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. Founded in 1948 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, DICK'S is a leading omni-channel retailer and an iconic brand in sport and culture. Its banners include DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Going Going Gone! in addition to the experiential retail concepts DICK'S House of Sport and Golf Galaxy Performance Center. As owner and operator of the Foot Locker Business, including Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos, DICK'S serves the global sneaker community across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, plus a licensed store presence in Europe, the Middle East and Asia. DICK'S also owns and operates GameChanger, a youth sports mobile platform for live streaming, scheduling, communications and scorekeeping.


Driven by its belief that sports have the power to change lives, DICK'S has been a longtime champion for youth sports and, together with its Foundation, has donated millions of dollars to support under-resourced teams and athletes through the Sports Matter program and other community-based initiatives. Additional information about DICK'S business, corporate giving and employment opportunities can be found on[dicks.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=1234587859&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dickssportinggoods.com%2F&a=dicks.com) ,[investors.dicks.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=2128616122&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.dicks.com%2Finvestors%2Fdefault.aspx&a=investors.dicks.com) ,[sportsmatter.org](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=3740838999&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sportsmatter.org%2F&a=sportsmatter.org) ,[dickssportinggoods.jobs](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=1031703479&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dickssportinggoods.jobs%2F&a=dickssportinggoods.jobs) and on[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=288995944&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fdickssportinggoods%2F%3Fhl%3Den&a=Instagram) ,[TikTok](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=1403540223&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40dickssportinggoods%3Flang%3Den&a=TikTok) ,[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=858299645&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fdickssportinggoods%2F&a=Facebook) and[X](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761879-1&h=1513594758&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FDICKS%3Fref_src%3Dtwsrc%255Egoogle%257Ctwcamp%255Eserp%257Ctwgr%255Eauthor&a=X) .
